why: E21 (PRED-020, EP-0032) passed its decision prediction P2 (state coupling a >= 0.5 * T in every decision row with T > 0) with a thin margin at (0.6, 0.2): per-seed a - 0.5T was 0.0001 to 0.026, mean 0.011, SE 0.0045 (about 2.5 SE), and one seed sat on the threshold. A pass with that margin can come from seed luck. E22 reruns E21 exactly on six seeds never used before (2201-2206) to see whether P2 replicates before C-058 builds on it.

prior_art.already_known: As PRED-020 (Pollaczek-Khinchine/Kingman, SRPT insensitivity, MSJ FCFS head-of-line blocking, fragmentation hurts). Replicating a thin pass on fresh seeds is standard practice.

experiment.grid: trace_like, first_fit, rows (rho, pi) in {(0.55, 0.2), (0.6, 0.2), (0.6, 0.1)} x seeds 2201-2206 x horizons {160k, 320k}; fcfs arms BASE, F, RP, CS, CM, U; srpt BASE, F, U. 72 tasks, 648 simulations, CPU only.

predictions.P0_P5: PRED-020's P0-P5, word for word, re-graded on seeds 2201-2206 by analyze_e21's grade(). P3 failed in E21; it stays as written and is expected to fail again (not a decision).
predictions.R1: DECISION. P2 replicates: PRED-020's P2 rule passes on seeds 2201-2206 (in every decision row where fcfs F, CS, CM, U are STABLE and mean T > 0, mean a >= 0.5 * mean T; at least one such row).
predictions.R2: The margin is resolved: at (0.6, 0.2), over the 12 seeds 2101-2106 and 2201-2206, the one-sided 95% lower bound of mean (a - 0.5T), t with 11 df, is > 0. Requires (0.6, 0.2) scorable in both E21 and E22.
predictions.R3: Reported, not a decision: the same lower bound on E22's six seeds alone (t, 5 df).

pre_committed_consequence.P0_fail: Instrument broken: stop, report, do not grade R1.
pre_committed_consequence.R1_pass_R2_pass: P2 replicated and its margin is resolved within this model: state coupling carries more than half of fcfs's fragmentation residual at (0.6, 0.2) and (0.55, 0.2). Proceed to C-058.
pre_committed_consequence.R1_pass_R2_fail: P2 replicated as a rule, but the margin over 0.5T is not resolved: write 'a is about half of T or more', not 'more than half'. a > 0 itself is not in question. Proceed to C-058.
pre_committed_consequence.R1_fail: P2 did not replicate. Downgrade EP-0032's P2 PASS to 'passed once, not replicated'; state that a's share of T is near 0.5 and unresolved. Stop before C-058's main run and report to the owner.
pre_committed_consequence.R1_unscorable: Any needed cell UNKNOWN: the replication was not obtained. Do not interpret. Stop before C-058's main run and report to the owner.

declared_unknowns: PRED-020's declared unknowns, unchanged (CS also breaks busy-period arrival-order correlation; srpt U work match; other mixes, loads, placements, penalty shapes; real clusters).
R2 pools the E21 seeds whose thin margin prompted this replication; it is a precision estimate, not an independent test. R1 is the independent test.
Under a true margin of exactly 0, R1 passes about half the time; R1 alone cannot establish a >= 0.5T. That is why R2 is reported beside it.
rules: No edits to this file, run_e22.py or analyze_e22.py after the sealing commit.
run_e20.py is used at its sealed state; C-058 instrumentation is added only after E22's results are committed.
If more than one third of cells are UNKNOWN, report that before any grade interpretation.
Keep failed predictions; do not re-grade with new thresholds.
Report each graded mean with its per-seed SD and SE next to the grade.
